_comment: docforge template + theme registry. Axes are independent: a template declares STRUCTURE, a theme declares APPEARANCE, neither knows the engine. Add a document type by adding a row here, not by writing a new script.

base-a4.note: A4 portrait, flowing sections with running header/footer. The default for briefs, dossiers, reports.

deck-16x9.note: 16:9 landscape, 338.67x190.5mm = 960x540pt, one .slide per page. @page margin MUST be 0 or every slide splits into two pages and the browser furniture prints on all of them. Chromium only — WeasyPrint has no JS and the deck axis assumes browser rendering.

theme_notes.light: DEFAULT. Light background, accent rules, tinted callouts. Passes the print-light gate profile.
theme_notes.dark: Screen-only. Deliberately FAILS the print-light gate so it cannot be delivered to paper by accident — pair it with the screen-dark profile.
theme_notes.print: Toner-frugal: no background fills at all, hairlines only. For anything that will be photocopied.
theme_notes.accessible: High contrast, larger type, stronger hierarchy. Pair with the accessible gate profile.
